description: An employee working on Quality sampling reported discomfort in the left foot area. Assessment showed a minor crush injury. Ice and rest were prescribed. No time was lost. [SEP] Revised risk assessment for Quality sampling. Updated permit-to-work requirements.

While performing Painting operations with Compressed Air Line, a worker experienced a hearing loss to the right knee. Emergency medical services transported the employee to the clinic for treatment. [SEP] Replaced Compressed Air Line component. Added daily inspection checklist. [SEP] I noticed something was wrong when I heard an unusual sound from the equipment. I immediately notified the shift supervisor.

I immediately notified the shift supervisor.
